extra_sources.note: Models beyond the 46 chart Mags come from the Ephinea client: the AFS archives above plus per-slot override files in data/ephinea/default/{model,texture}/File N.prs, which replace or append slots. Cameras were fitted against the in-game 64px icons in ItemKTep4.afs (entry = skin for skins below 57, skin - 1 above); Sonic (icon predates the replacement model), Present* and Saraswati (no icon) use manually chosen views framed at the icon extent.
